Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 4 Ingredients 1 cup sliced strawberries 1 cup low-fat granola 1 cup blueberries or other fruit 1 cup low-fat plain yogurt Directions Wash hands with soap and water. Divide the strawberries among 4 glasses. Sprinkle 1/4 cup granola over the strawberries in each glass. Divide blueberries and place on top of granola. Spoon 1/4 cup yogurt on top of the blueberries. Enjoy right away. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Substitute any frozen and thawed, canned and drained, or fresh chopped fruit for strawberries and blueberries.
